description: This Dart source file defines the AppConfig class, which centralizes access to environment variables loaded via flutter_dotenv. It provides default URLs for API, WebSocket, and SSE connections, handles loading the environment file, logs warnings when environment variables are missing, and provides getters for configuration values like API base URL, realtime URL, events URL, and mock mode.

classes.name: AppConfig
classes.description: A singleton class providing access to environment variables and configuration settings for the app, including URLs and mode flags, with default fallbacks and logging.

methods.name: ensureLoaded
methods.description: Loads the environment variables from the .env file asynchronously, ensuring this is only done once.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the API base URL, either from environment or default, with warnings if missing.

methods.name: realtimeUrl
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket URL for realtime updates, constructed from the apiBaseUrl.

methods.name: eventsUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for server-sent events, constructed from the apiBaseUrl.

methods.name: mockMode
methods.description: Indicates whether the application is running in mock mode, based on environment variable.
